Hi Aaron —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

What we heard (short):
- Primary use case: document summarization + redaction for customer support knowledge base (reduce avg handle time, deflect common tickets).
- Success metrics: 25–30% reduction in handle time in first 6 months; P0 = no PII leakage; cost target <$0.002/token on steady-state.
- Infra constraints: data residency in US; SOC2 required; procurement timeline aims to close contract by Dec.

Stakeholder mapping (please confirm/change):
- Champion: Aaron Li (Director of AI) — product & technical sponsor
- Economic buyer: Laura Jennings (CFO) — budgeting/approval
- Procurement: Sophie Tremblay — contracts/procurement process
- Security: Rajiv Menon — InfoSec & vendor risk

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm stakeholders above and their preferred intro cadence?
2) I’ll send a champion enablement one-pager and ROI talk tracks aimed at Laura and the execs (attached: Redwood-01_overview.pdf).
3) Technical deep-dive with Rafael (30–60m) to walk integration, data residency, SOC2 posture — propose next Wed 11/11 or Thu 11/12; what works?
4) Procurement kickoff — Sophie, can we get the procurement timeline and a list of required docs (SLA, DPA, SOC2)?

Attachments: Redwood-01_overview.pdf (attached), SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (will send if useful).

Thanks again — happy to align on anything I missed.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Sophie / Team — thanks for the details. Quick confirmations from engineering/security side: 

- SOC2: we’ve attached SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (sent to Sophie by Marissa) and can provide the full report under NDA.
- Audit logs: we support streaming audit logs to a customer-owned S3 or syslog endpoint; we also surface per-request metadata in Redwood Console.
- KMS/data residency: customer-managed keys via KMS are supported for private deployments; hosted customers can use envelope encryption with customer KMS integrations. All data can be kept in US regions per your requirement.
- References: Dylan will share names; we can also provide short technical reference calls.

Next steps: Rafael (solutions engineering) to run the technical deep-dive Wed 11/11 14:00 PT and Monica will follow up on contract points. Sophie — if that time works I’ll send the calendar invite and a 30m agenda focused on integration and security deliverables.
